name: lingo
label: Lingo
css: .style-lingo { background: var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF); position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; padding: 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12); } .style-lingo::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -40%; right: -10%; width: 500px; height: 500px; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #58cc02) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.08; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; } .style-lingo .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--slide-text, #3c3c3c); margin: 0; max-width: 85%; z-index: 2; position: relative; letter-spacing: -1px; } .style-lingo .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--slide-text, #3c3c3c); margin: 0; max-width: 90%; z-index: 2; position: relative; } .style-lingo .step { position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 32px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text, #3c3c3c); opacity: 0.06; line-height: 1; z-index: 1; } .style-lingo .brand { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-text, #3c3c3c); position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 32px; z-index: 2; letter-spacing: 0.5px; } .slide-code.style-lingo { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #2d2d2d 100%); color: #f5f5f5; } .slide-code.style-lingo::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #58cc02) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.04; } .slide-code.style-lingo .hook { color: #f5f5f5; } .slide-code.style-lingo .text { color: #e0e0e0; } .slide-code.style-lingo .step { color: #f5f5f5; opacity: 0.08; } .slide-code.style-lingo .brand { color: #b0b0b0; } .slide-insight.style-lingo { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #2d2d2d 100%); } .slide-insight.style-lingo::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #58cc02) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.06; } .slide-insight.style-lingo .insight-text { font-size: 56px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; color: #ffffff; max-width: 90%; z-index: 2; position: relative; margin: 0; }
